title: Owned Shiny Sparkles Begone [Cobblemon]
description: Removes the sparkles and sounds when looking at owned Shiny Pokémon
body:
## This resourcepack requires the [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) mod to work

This very simple resourcepack removes the sparkles and sounds when looking at owned Shiny Pokémon. Wild Shinies will still make sounds and sparkle, so you don't have to worry about missing them with this resourcepack installed.
